title: Senior Infra Engineer: take-home project + reviewer schedule
text:
Senior Infra Engineer: take-home project + reviewer schedule

["From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Senior Infra Engineer - project prompt and submission details

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for interviewing with the team. As discussed, please find the take-home project attached: senior-infra-project-prompt.pdf. High level: a short design + a small prototype you can run locally (should take ~6 hours).

Deadlines and ask:
- Please submit your ZIP or link to a public repo by EOD Monday, Nov 16 (we can extend if you need extra time — let me know).
- Include a README with instructions to run any demo and a short design.md (1–2 pages) outlining tradeoffs.
- For code submissions, small scripts are fine; no need to productionize. We value clarity and reasoning.

Allowed: standard Python data-science and infra libs (requests, boto3, numpy, asyncio). If you want to use any experimental tooling (e.g., infra-specific SDKs), flag it in the README.

I’ve CC'd Laura and Marissa — they’ll handle scheduling the review panel once you submit. Please reply here to confirm receipt and if the Monday deadline works.

Attachments: senior-infra-project-prompt.pdf (project prompt, success criteria, timebox)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
", "From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@gmail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Infra Engineer - project prompt and submission details

Hi Rishi —

Thanks, I got the prompt and will aim for Monday EOD. Two quick clarifying questions:
1) For the prototype, is it okay to include small Dockerfile and a lightweight container?
2) Is there a preferred format for the design (markdown is fine?)

If you’d prefer a 48-hour extension to make the container smoother I can ask, but I can deliver a simpler demo by Monday.

—Samira

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Infra Engineer - project prompt and submission details

Thanks for the quick reply, Samira —

1) Dockerfile is fine, a minimal container is totally acceptable.
2) Markdown is perfect for the design doc.

If you think you need a 48-hour buffer, say so now and we’ll extend to Wednesday EOD. Otherwise stick with Monday.

Laura/Marissa: tagging you to confirm reviewers and give the rubric — would like two reviewers (Marissa + one engineering lead). Can you confirm availability the week of Nov 15 for a 45–60 minute panel review? I’ll send calendar invites once you confirm.

Thanks,
Rishi

Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Infra Engineer - project prompt and submission details

All good — I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon (Nov 16/17) and can be reviewer #2 if Marissa will take the other slot. I’ve uploaded a quick reviewer rubric (reviewer-rubric.xlsx) with suggested time split: 20 min read, 20 min demo + questions, 20 min scoring/discussion (we can shorten to 45m).

Marissa, can you confirm you can take the lead on the demo questions? I’ll open a calendar block and invite Samira + the panel when we have a submission in hand.

Rishi — do you want me to add the rubric into the candidate's shared folder?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Eng Manager, Platform Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reviewer-rubric.xlsx

Confirmed — I’ve penciled in Wed Nov 17 1:00–1:45 PM PT for the review panel and sent calendar invites to Samira and the panel. I’ll lead the demo questions and will allocate ~15 minutes for follow-ups.

Rishi/Laura: I also added the rubric and a short note to the shared folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-hiring-prompts). If Samira requests the 48-hour extension, I’m fine moving the panel to Fri.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
